## Checklist

- [ ] My tool/change follows the [tool module pattern](docs/architecture/README.md)
- [ ] The tool is registered in `assets/js/config/tools.config.js`
- [ ] Keyboard navigation works (Tab, Enter, Escape)
- [ ] ARIA attributes are present on interactive elements
- [ ] No `console.error` or unhandled promise rejections
- [ ] Tool has a `mount(container)` export and optionally `unmount()`
- [ ] Tool cleans up event listeners and intervals in `unmount()`
- [ ] Copy/download actions use shared `clipboardService` / `downloadService`
